card.name: Small words before drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, with, a, other) that sit right before a drug name or drug class in label text. Also a few digits in section numbers.

modes.label: Link word before a drug
modes.description: A short word such as of, to, with or a that comes just before a named drug or drug class.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit or gap inside a numbered label section or a number range.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in a drug label just before the next drug name is named.
